## Status: AI-assisted work in progress

This paper was developed with substantial AI assistance.
It is currently undergoing formalization in Lean 4, which has already exposed errors in earlier versions.
Results, including ones stated as theorems, may still change.

**Preprint:** [arXiv:2608.17766](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.17766) (v1 18 Aug 2026, v2 23 Aug 2026) · [PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.17766)

## Summary

Players repeatedly form and dissolve nested binding agreements and evaluate outcomes by discounted long-run payoffs.
The paper asks whether the grand coalition persists once reached and whether it is eventually reached, and how the answer depends on the rule for sharing the surplus.
See the arXiv abstract for the precise statements.

## Citation

Heitzig, J. (2026) *Does the grand coalition form? Persistence, arrival, and the role of the sharing rule in a dynamic process of nested binding agreements*. arXiv preprint arXiv:2608.17766. Available at: <https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.17766>.
